answer_text:
Here is a roundup of some of the **best stocks to buy now in June 2026**, according to top analysts and financial publications:

---

### 📈 Market Overview
The stock market has been volatile so far in 2026 due to the Iran conflict, tariff uncertainty, and fears of a weakening economy. Although the S&P 500 is close to an all-time high, many stocks look extremely attractive for long-term investors to consider buying.

---

### 🔥 Top Stock Picks for June 2026

---

#### 1. 🚗 **Uber (UBER)**
Uber continues to benefit from steady demand in both ride-hailing and delivery. DA Davidson analyst Tom White kept a Buy rating and $107 target on Uber stock. On TipRanks, analysts have a Strong Buy consensus rating on Uber stock based on 27 Buys and two Holds assigned in the past three months. The average UBER stock price target of $105.96 per share implies 43.07% upside potential.

---

#### 2. ⚡ **Vistra Corp (VST)**
Vistra is a major U.S. power producer that is benefiting from rising electricity demand tied to data centers, AI, and electrification. Vistra has been expanding its clean energy and battery storage assets while keeping steady cash flow from its traditional power fleet. Jefferies analyst Julien Dumoulin Smith reiterated a Buy rating and $212 target on Vistra stock, saying the stock now looks cheap after a 35% drop since late 2025.

---

#### 3. ✈️ **Vertical Aerospace (EVTL)**
Vertical Aerospace is working on its VX4 aircraft, which aims to offer quiet, zero-emission urban flights. It is making progress on testing, certification, and partnerships with airlines and travel operators. While still years from full commercial service, analysts believe EVTL offers long-term upside if electric aviation scales the way many expect. EVTL stock has a Strong Buy consensus rating based on four Buys and one Hold. The average EVTL stock price target implies upside potential of 350.62%.

---

#### 4. 🌎 **MercadoLibre (MELI)**
MercadoLibre is often referred to as the Amazon of Latin America, operating an e-commerce marketplace with a dominant presence in some of the region's most populous nations, including Brazil and Argentina. The marketplace saw $19 billion in merchandise volume in the first quarter of 2026, up 42% from the same quarter in 2025. Mercado Pago processes nearly $350 billion in annualized payment volume, with over three-quarters of that volume coming from outside its e-commerce platform.

---

#### 5. 🏡 **Airbnb (ABNB)**
In the first quarter of 2026, more than 156 million nights and experiences were booked on Airbnb's platform, with a total booking value of over $29 billion, representing 19% year-over-year growth. Airbnb is not only massive and growing quickly, but also highly profitable — it generated $4.5 billion in free cash flow and achieved a 36% FCF margin over the past 12 months.

---

#### 6. 📡 **Vishay Precision Group (VPG)**
Vishay Precision Group's precision measurement and sensing technologies business is booming as it rides long-term megatrends across semiconductor equipment, data centers, avionics, military and space, and beyond. Its first-quarter bookings jumped 25.5% sequentially to $102.1 million, marking the third-highest quarterly level in VPG's history. Vishay Precision is projected to grow its adjusted earnings by 100% in 2026 to $0.98 a share and then expand its bottom line by another 91% next year.

---

### ⚠️ Disclaimer
This is **not financial advice**. Stock investing involves risk, and past performance does not guarantee future results. Choosing the best stocks to buy today depends on your personal financial situation. Always do your own research or consult a licensed financial advisor before making investment decisions.
